title: Vesicate

inlines.v: VES'ICATE, verb transitive [Latin vesica, a little bladder. Gr. from to inflate.] To blister; to raise little bladders, or separate the cuticle by inflaming the skin. Celsus recommends to vesicate the external parts of wounds.
